---
name: Proposal
about: A new tool, view, option or dependency
labels: proposal
---

**What is missing, and what goes undone without it.** A vague mandate produces
vague work — the same standard the company itself applies to a new seat.

**What it costs.** Every tool the staff can call is a permanent part of the
surface they can act through; every option is a thing that can be set wrong.
Say what this adds weight to.

**What it replaces or removes.** Optional, but the strongest version of a
proposal here is one that nets out to less.
